answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 12231 Country: AU Title: Asalaamvalaikum, Can I wear cotton pants and it's so loose that you can't figure out the shape of the body and over that i wear kurta upto knees. and i also wear hizaab? Question: Asalaamvalaikum, Can I wear cotton pants and it's so loose that you can't figure out the shape of the body and over that i wear kurta upto knees. and i also wear hizaab? Answer ID: 12231 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 954/717=H/1430) It is prohibited to wear such a pant though it is loose. However, it right to wear kurta meant for women and worn by pious women, also it is good to observe hijab . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
